authority.process_termination_scope: GPU 0 only: terminate exact same-uid, exact-interpreter processes carrying the standalone --beyondg-gpu-keepalive marker after pidfd validation; never signal unknown GPU processes; the wrapper may stop only its own runner on an unknown conflict

forecast.basis: Ten retained PQN state files are expected from five checkpoints x two seeds; the prior corresponding state file was 51,113,850 bytes. The 16 GiB projection conservatively covers retained files, predecessor-successor overlap, evaluation artifacts, logs, compilation artifacts in the RAID run tree, and large estimation error; the separate reserve remains 8 GiB.
forecast.reserve_rule: max(8 GiB, 20% of projected remaining writes)

capacity_preflight.live_tree_rule: never move a live checkpoint tree
capacity_preflight.runtime_enforcement: recheck before every job and checkpoint; stop at a completed resumable checkpoint if the reserve is threatened

common_training.derived_compatibility_view_of: training; retained because the established checkpoint and evaluation helpers consume this schema, and validate_manifest checks agreement

evaluation.candidate_choice_boundary: The lr=2e-4 parent candidate was chosen before this rerun because it matches the upstream default learning rate; no schedule-restoration bug metric or rerun result selected it.
evaluation.gate: each seed must achieve at least 29/32 natural-start successes
evaluation.oracle_boundary: Success is scored by the project-owned TICK fixture and evaluator. Scripted kernel tests validate the encoded task contract; they are not independent external scientific ground truth.
evaluation.selection_bias_boundary: The same 32 validation states were used by prior development gates. This bounded rerun diagnoses the schedule under a fixed operational gate and is not held-out evidence of generalization.

operator_sequence: Use the committed SHA to create the exact clean RAID worktree.
Run the queue wrapper once with --smoke; it identity-checks the existing keepalive, supervises both runner and guard, and writes no checkpoint.
Run the queue wrapper once with no --job argument; it executes seed 110 then 111 and produces gate.json and result.json.
Do not invoke per-job mode for the planned run; it is a resume/debug surface and does not finalize the gate by itself.
execution.resume: only from a complete checkpoint with matching job identity, update, state hash, and execution-source hashes
execution.retention: retain all five checkpoints for both seeds
execution.source_hash_boundary: The runner hashes its manifest, runner/wrapper/guard/stop helper, shared base runner, and all directly imported HackRL modules on the loaded PQN/TICK path. Runtime package versions and module origins are recorded in run_contract.json.
execution.wrapper_only_boundary: GPU execution requires HACKRL_GPU_GUARD_ACTIVE=1 in addition to the existing device variables; the committed wrapper is the authorized setter and supervises runner and guard together.

normalization_diagnostic.checkpoints: both PQN candidates x seeds 110 and 111 at update 512
normalization_diagnostic.decision_rule: Descriptive mechanism check, not a configuration selector: any finite result with unchanged checkpoint hashes permits the predeclared schedule rerun. Missing, mutated, non-finite, or hash-mismatched evidence stops execution. The observed high disagreement strengthens the rationale for the rerun but is not itself a performance result.
normalization_diagnostic.fixed_observation_batch: the 512 fixed TICK initial worker states from seed 110 crossed with all 12 commanded goals
normalization_diagnostic.interpretation_boundary: train-mode batch-stat outputs are diagnostic only and are never reported as policy performance
measurements: greedy action disagreement overall and by goal
normalization_diagnostic.rerun_policy: The hash-bound artifact is immutable evidence. --diagnose-batch-renorm prints it without rewriting; a missing or changed artifact requires a reviewed manifest revision.

selection_and_stop.capacity_failure: stop before the next checkpoint write

training.batch_renorm_population: All collected rows enter BatchRenorm statistics before the valid-transition mask is applied to TD loss; this existing behavior is held fixed in the schedule rerun.
training.fixture_initializer_hidden_size_boundary: The canonical fixture initializer briefly constructs a discarded PPO learner at width 8; initialize_online_value_runner replaces that train state with the registered 1024-wide PQN before any action or training transition.

understood_as: First measure train-batch versus saved-running-stat Q values on the four completed PQN TICK checkpoints without mutating them. Then rerun only GC-PQN on fixed TICK-CLAIM for learner seeds 110 and 111 with the existing lr=2e-4 candidate, unchanged exploration/network/goals/reward/initialization/evaluation, 2-step collection, 256-transition shuffled minibatches, one epoch, and the same 16,777,216 physical transitions per seed. Do not launch LEO, Dual, SAC, mutant adaptation, or any automatic extension.

upstream_reference.claim_boundary: This is a schedule restoration inside the HackRL implementation, not an assertion that the complete upstream experiment has been reproduced.
intentional_non_upstream_controls: HackRL fixed TICK-CLAIM workshop12 fixture and rewards
existing GoalConditionedQ architecture and current-network one-step TD target
existing candidate exploration schedule 1.0 to 0.1 across the full physical-transition budget
constant Adam learning rate rather than the upstream default linear annealing schedule
upstream_reference.restored_mechanism: short online collection followed by a shared random permutation and sequential minibatch optimizer applications; no replay and no target network
